title: Optimizing siRNA Therapeutics Targeting HIF-1alpha: Computational Design, Screening, and Molecular Dynamics Simulation Studies.
authors: Shrivastava, Neeraj Kumar; Verma, Pratibha; Singh, Garima; Singh, Jyoti; Kumar, Anurag; Yadav, Sneha; Sonkar, Archana Bharti; Ansari, Mohd Nazam; S Saeedan, Abdulaziz; Akhter, Yusuf; A Aldossary, Sara; Kaithwas, Gaurav
one_liner_zh: 该研究用计算工具设计靶向HIF-1alpha mRNA的siRNA并进行分子动力学模拟，但核心是siRNA-mRNA/蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1alpha) is an important transcription factor regulating glycolysis, angiogenesis, metastasis, and erythropoiesis under hypoxic conditions in solid tumors. Small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) have emerged as a promising therapeutic approach for solid tumors by selectively silencing target genes. This study explored siRNA-mediated degradation of HIF-1alpha by specifically targeting HIF-1alpha mRNA. We retrieved the HIF-1alpha gene sequence from the database and used various computational tools like siDirect and OligoWalk to get potential 19-21nts long siRNAs. Furthermore, these siRNAs were screened using parameters like sequence specificity, BLASTn, secondary structure formation, GC content, binding affinity between siRNA and mRNA, and thermodynamic properties. The potential siRNAs were further evaluated through molecular docking studies for interaction with the human Argonaute-2 protein (hAgo2), followed by molecular dynamics simulation studies. Post-MD studies revealed S4 (5'UAUAUGGUGAUGAUGUGGC3') as the most potential siRNA candidate against HIF-1alpha, based on root mean square deviation (RMSD), root mean square fluctuation (RMSF), radius of gyration (Rg), and H-bond analysis. Molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area (MMPBSA) analysis was also performed to further validate the selected siRNA candidates, which further affirmed S4 (5'UAUAUGGUGAUGAUGUGGC3') as a potential candidate against HIF-1alpha.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）是一种重要的转录因子，在实体瘤的缺氧条件下调控糖酵解、血管生成、转移和红细胞生成。小干扰RNA（siRNAs）通过选择性沉默靶基因，已成为实体瘤的一种有前景的治疗方法。本研究探讨了通过特异性靶向HIF-1alpha mRNA实现siRNA介导的HIF-1alpha降解。我们从数据库中检索了HIF-1alpha基因序列，并使用siDirect和OligoWalk等多种计算工具获取潜在的19-21nt长度的siRNAs。此外，这些siRNAs通过序列特异性、BLASTn、二级结构形成、GC含量、siRNA与mRNA之间的结合亲和力以及热力学性质等参数进行了筛选。潜在的siRNAs进一步通过分子对接研究评估其与人Argonaute-2蛋白（hAgo2）的相互作用，随后进行分子动力学模拟研究。MD后研究显示，基于均方根偏差（RMSD）、均方根波动（RMSF）、回转半径（Rg）和氢键分析，S4（5'UAUAUGGUGAUGAUGUGGC3'）是针对HIF-1alpha的最有潜力的siRNA候选物。还进行了分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MMPBSA）分析以进一步验证选定的siRNA候选物，该分析进一步确认S4（5'UAUAUGGUGAUGAUGUGGC3'）是针对HIF-1alpha的潜在候选物。
